description:
Activate Sash and Waistcoat by paying {1} due to Zirda, manifesting the top card of your library.
When the manifested card enters, Case of the Uneaten Feast and Davvol trigger.
Resolve the Case of the Uneaten Feast trigger, causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Davvol trigger, adding {B} and causing you to lose 1 life
Repeat.
